rationale_one_line: Router's value is structural, a routing diagram is the whole story, so SCHEMATIC carries it; gallery is the only preset outside the 14-entry window and its flagship-minimal white-and-blue reads as clean infrastructure.
writing_tone_notes: Builder-direct and infra-precise. Latency numbers and endpoint changes over adjectives. Admiring by contrast, never superlative. Contractions where natural. The model picks itself, on your box, before the call leaves.
do_rules: Lead the diagram with the on-box embedder deciding between providers
Land exactly one stat as the big_number beat (the 40-70% cost cut)
Credit Andrew by name in the close, peer-to-peer
Keep latency (under 50ms) and cost (40-70%) on separate scenes
dont_rules: No superlatives, let the contrast carry the praise
Do not repeat any scene phrase in the tweet or the Why-this-one
No question hooks, no em or en dashes, no semicolons
